description: The Scope of work for the work of Annual Maintenance Works of generator, turbine, control system & switchyard and emergency breakdown Maintenance works at Sharavathy Generating Station includes the following equipments Generator and its auxiliaries, Turbine and its auxiliaries, 220KV Generator transformer and bay equipments. Excitation, governor and protective relaying and breakdown Maintenance works. The detailed Technical specification and scope of work is as per enclosed Section- I, II & III of tender documents.
